Overview

This hackathon challenges developers to build AI pipelines capable of processing complex finance documents that typically break OCR and LLM systems.

Using HyperAPI, participants will extract accurate, structured data from messy invoices, tax forms, and other financial documents, competing across two tracks for cash prizes and early API access.

Company Overview

Hyperbots Inc. transforms Finance & Accounting operations using proprietary AI agents that autonomously read, reconcile, validate, and post financial data across complex procure-to-pay and order-to-cash workflows.

Its AI Co-Pilots operate on a finance-specific architecture spanning language, vision, reasoning, prediction, and exception handling.

Hyperbots integrates with major ERPs and maintains ISO 27001, SOC 1 Type 2, and SOC 2 Type 2 certifications. The company raised $9 million in venture funding during 2024–25.

Themes

Track 1: The Financial Gauntlet

Financial documents such as invoices, tax forms, and insurance claims often contain nested tables, multi-page line items, and inconsistent layouts that break traditional OCR and LLM pipelines. These documents require systems that have a financial context and that can also maintain numerical accuracy. In this track, participants will work with complex financial documents. Focus Areas: • Multi-page invoices with 100s line items • IRS Form 1040 tax documents • Unstructured insurance claims with mixed layouts • Building an extraction pipeline using HyperAPI • Converting documents into clean, structured, machine-readable data • Maintaining accuracy of key financial values and numerical consistency Evaluation Criteria: • Extraction accuracy • Mathematical validation • Absence of hallucinations • Overall pipeline robustness

Ai For Intelligent Financial Document ProcessingRead more

Track 2: Test Your Own Document (TYOD)

Many financial workflows rely on documents that break standard automation systems, such as messy vendor invoices, scanned reports, complex tax forms, or poorly structured PDFs. In this track, participants bring their own challenging financial documents and use HyperAPI to build a pipeline that can parse and extract structured financial data from them. Focus Areas: • Processing messy vendor invoices • Handling scanned reports • Extracting data from complex tax forms • Working with poorly structured PDFs • Demonstrating reliable machine-readable financial data extraction using HyperAPI Outcomes: • If a document that a participant brings breaks the API, they can win enterprise credits. • If a participant successfully builds a pipeline, they can receive early API access.

Eligibility

All participants are eligible to register for HyperAPI Hackathon

Rules

1. Team Size

  • Participants can compete individually or in teams of up to 4 members.

2. Use of HyperAPI

  • All submissions must use HyperAPI as part of the document processing pipeline.

3. Original Work

  • All solutions must be built during the hackathon period.
  • Pre-built projects are not allowed.

4. Submission Deadline

  • Teams must submit their final pipeline and results before the official hackathon deadline.

5. Evaluation Criteria

  • Track 1
    • Solutions will be judged on extraction accuracy, numerical consistency, absence of hallucinations, and overall pipeline robustness.
  • Track 2
    • If a participant can break the API, they will receive enterprise credits.
    • If a participant successfully builds a working pipeline, they will receive early API access.

6. Track Participation

  • Teams can participate in one or both challenge tracks (Financial Gauntlet or Test Your Own Document).

7. Document Usage

  • Documents used in submissions must be financial in nature.
  • Documents must be real-world financial documents.
  • Documents should be appropriate for testing extraction pipelines.

8. Fair Play

  • Any form of plagiarism, misuse of datasets, or violation of event guidelines may lead to disqualification.
